attributes.description: Distribution opsdir-adapter-servicenow (import opsdir_adapter_servicenow), registered via entry point opsdir.adapters:servicenow; depends on opsdir.
attributes.external_dependencies: ["ServiceNow Table API (GET /api/now/table/change_request, /api/now/table/sysapproval_approver, /api/now/table/<work-ticket table>, read-only; drafts for POST /api/now/table/<work-ticket table> are files a person posts)"]
attributes.purpose: ServiceNow as an ITSM add-on (kind itsm): reads the change tickets the record's change records link (servicenow:<number>) as evidence, one instance per record (enforced). Importer servicenow/change-requests reads Table API answers or JSON list exports of change_request + sysapproval_approver (raw UTC values; the state map is keyed by change model through estate settings: servicenow-standard-state-models, servicenow-legacy-state-models + servicenow-legacy-states for pre-Geneva codes; approval raw values through servicenow-approval-values; change type from `type`), and linked work tickets from the site-approved task-derived table servicenow-ticket-table names (ciamTicketKind work, states through servicenow-ticket-states, due_date -> ciamTicketDue). A read-only collector pages GET /api/now/table/... until an empty page, with basic, bearer or client-certificate (mutual TLS) credentials. Work-ticket drafts (Adapter.ticket_draft, drafts.py): the Table API create body for that table per owning team (servicenow-ticket-groups: team -> group sys_id; servicenow-ticket-fields: defaults), a file a person posts; opsdir never writes to the instance.

attributes.name: display_only
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "r", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "a change_request or work-ticket record"}, {"name": "times", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": false, "description": "the record's date/time fields (default CHANGE_TIMES)"}]
attributes.purpose: Why a record can't be compared: its state or the time fields `times` are display text (unknown time zone) rather than raw values; None when raw. Change records check their planned/work window fields (CHANGE_TIMES), work tickets due_date, work_start and work_end (WORK_TIMES).

attributes.name: read_changes
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "files", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true}, {"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "patterns", "type": "tuple", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": false, "description": "when the export was taken (required)"}]
attributes.purpose: Importer servicenow/change-requests: each ticket the record links that the export holds, its own import group under ou=servicenow,ou=tickets: change_request records as change tickets (with their sysapproval_approver rows), and, when servicenow-ticket-table names the work-ticket table, linked numbers found there as work tickets (work_facts; a number in both tables is read as the change ticket); refuses an export from another instance than the record's tickets were read from (one instance per record); notices for the settings' problems, unlinked tickets, linked ones missing (never removed; a hint when the work-ticket table isn't set), display-only records, models named in neither or both state-model settings, unmapped approval values and work-ticket states, fields never carried, error answers, several instances.

attributes.name: change_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps: each chunk of linked tickets' change_request pages and, when servicenow-ticket-table names the work-ticket table, the same numbers' pages from that table with WORK_FIELDS (each page after a non-empty one); then, once every change_request chunk ended on an empty page, the approval-record pages of the change sys_ids found; GETs only.

attributes.name: instance_maps
attributes.purpose: What the operator's estate settings say of the instance (InstanceMaps): the change models on the standard state model (servicenow-standard-state-models), those still on the legacy pre-Geneva codes (servicenow-legacy-state-models), the legacy codes' neutral states (servicenow-legacy-states via ticket_state_map), the approval field's raw values' neutral approvals (servicenow-approval-values via ticket_map), the work-ticket table (work_table) and its state codes' neutral states (servicenow-ticket-states, read only when the table is named), with the settings' problems.

attributes.name: ticket_body
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "r", "type": "TicketRequest", "description": "The team's findings (core.contract)"}, {"name": "group", "type": "str", "description": "The team's assignment group sys_id"}, {"name": "defaults", "type": "iterable of (field, value)", "description": "servicenow-ticket-fields pairs, raw values"}]
attributes.purpose: A team's TicketRequest as the ServiceNow Table API create body (JSON text) of a work ticket: the operator's default fields (first of a field used, drafted fields left out), then short_description (title), description (plain text from connectors.handoff.request_lines), assignment_group (the team's group sys_id) and due_date (earliest do-by, end of that UTC day 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59'; none without one).

attributes.name: how_to_file
attributes.purpose: How a person files a ServiceNow work-ticket draft: the request line (POST /api/now/table/<table>?sysparm_input_display_value=false) and a curl with placeholders for their own credential (bearer token or --user), run from the tickets folder; the instance host from the record's tickets when they were read from one instance, else a placeholder; then how to link the answered number (ciamTicketRef servicenow:<number>).

attributes.name: ticket_draft
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "description": "The record (its estate settings)"}, {"name": "r", "type": "TicketRequest", "description": "One owning team's findings"}]
attributes.purpose: Adapter.ticket_draft of the ServiceNow add-on: TicketDraft of one team's findings: the create body for the work-ticket table (servicenow-ticket-table) assigned to the team's group (servicenow-ticket-groups, matched any case) with the operator's defaults (servicenow-ticket-fields), or body None with problems naming the setting to give and the opsdir setting command (table unset or unusable, team without a group, group not a 32-hex sys_id); the mapping settings' own problems and drafted fields named in defaults as notes; never a credential.
attributes.returns: {"type": "TicketDraft", "description": "(body JSON text or None, 'json', how lines, problems)"}

attributes.name: work_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "r", "type": "dict", "description": "The record as the Table API gives it (raw or raw+display values)"}, {"name": "host", "type": "str or None", "description": "The instance host (None: no address)"}, {"name": "table", "type": "str", "description": "The work-ticket table"}, {"name": "maps", "type": "InstanceMaps", "description": "The operator's settings (work_states)"}]
attributes.purpose: The ciamTicket attributes of one work-ticket record of the operator's task-derived table: ciamTicketKind work (no approval), ciamTitle, ciamProviderRef sys_id, ciamDocUrl Table API record URL, ciamTicketState through servicenow-ticket-states (maps.work_states), ciamTicketNativeState, ciamTicketDue from due_date, ciamTicketWorkStart/End from work_start/work_end, ciamTicketFact WORK_FACT_FIELDS raw.
attributes.returns: {"type": "dict", "description": "{TICKET_ATTRS attribute: value or tuple or None} for ticket_entry"}

attributes.name: work_table
attributes.purpose: The work-ticket table the operator names in servicenow-ticket-table, or None when not named or not usable (not a lower-case ServiceNow table name, or change_request / sysapproval_approver), with why not usable.

attributes.description: Package opsdir-adapter-servicenow only. (1) Adapter.ticket_draft: (Directory, TicketRequest) -> TicketDraft, body = Table API create body for POST /api/now/table/{table}?sysparm_input_display_value=false: short_description, description (plain text, connectors.handoff.request_lines), assignment_group (sys_id), due_date (earliest do-by, 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' UTC), plus operator defaults; settings without defaults: servicenow-ticket-table (the site-approved task-derived table), servicenow-ticket-groups ('<team>=<group sys_id>, ...'), servicenow-ticket-fields (extra '<field>=<value>' defaults, e.g. impact=3, urgency=3); a missing setting or unmapped team -> TicketDraft(None, ..., problems naming the setting and the opsdir setting command); how = request line + curl with credential placeholders. (2) Read-back: the collector/importer also reads the linked numbers that are work tickets from servicenow-ticket-table (not change_request), writing ciamTicket with ciamTicketKind=work, ciamTicketState via a state mapping setting (servicenow-ticket-states '<state code>=<neutral state>'), ciamTicketDue from due_date, assignment group etc. as ciamTicketFact. Unit tests. README.
attributes.name: 612c ServiceNow: work-ticket draft (task-derived table) + read-back
